current_detail: The 75 x 150 mm two-PCB model is repartitioned from functional islands rather than the inherited R1 pin layout. The front UI/radio PCB now owns S3, C5, all three complete nRF24 paths, front RP, microSD and the TVP5150 decoder; the rear RF/power PCB owns CC1101, VHF/UHF voice, FM/SW/AM/LW/Airband, audio, K331 FPV, M5, U214, rear RP, power and safety. The ten main SMA ports are split 5 + 5, and the accepted Molex 73415-2063 C588480 vertical SMT MMCX provides the separate rear-face FPV RX 5.8G port between the rear SMA groups and above U214. K331 remains rear-local while TVP5150 is UI-local, so M1 carries one 75-ohm CVBS signal instead of an 11-line LCD_CAM bus; nine obsolete M1 signals are released and eight contacts remain spare. Front and rear RPs each use 45/48 GPIO. The official K331 pinout marks pin 6 RSSI as NC, so no RSSI function is promised and rear GPIO15 remains free; CVBS decoder lock remains the supported signal-presence evidence. The generated placement has zero same-face collisions and 1.44 mm minimum opposing clearance against 0.70 mm required. The MMCX body leaves 5.72 mm to the nearest SMA, its 12-mm handling envelope leaves 1.95 mm to SMA and exactly 0.70 mm to U214, and no tail enters the sandwich. Readable public inner views are split one PCB per diagram while the complete numbered projection remains machine evidence only. The sole current H1 blocker remains one AKK-controlled K331 production package with maximum XYZ, land pattern and packaging/soldering/reflow evidence; purchasing, KiCad and fabrication remain unauthorized.
